The [Al-Futtaim Group](https://www.alfuttaim.com/en/our-brands/) owns and operates over 200 global and regional brands in the UAE across automotive, retail, real estate, and financial sectors. Major names include Toyota, IKEA, Marks & Spencer, Honda, and Zara. [](https://www.alfuttaim.com/en/)

- Toyota and Lexus
